General information.Name: ecoinvent 3.11 Dataset Documentation 'lemon production – MX – lemon'
General information.Category: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/111 Crop Production/1113 Fruit and Tree Nut Farming/111320 Citrus (except Orange) Groves
General information.Description: This dataset represents the production of 1 kg of lemons. The average yield from 2009 - 2012 is 13.8 t/ha. The data are representative for lemons production in Mexico used for the export market. Mineral NPK fertiliser input is 33-0-10 kg/ha. Organic fertilisers applied amount to 1.67 m3/ha of liquid manure and 1.07 t/ha of solid manure. Total active ingredients (a.i.) applied as pesticides amount to 28.6 kg a.i./ha. The dataset was modelled within the project 'World Food LCA database (WFLDB)'. The aim of this project was to provide inventories of a broad variety of agricultural products and processes and to cover for each product at least 50% of the global export market. This activity starts with the nursery producing fruit tree seedlings and ends with the waste treatment after clearing the orchard. The dataset includes all activities of a year in the productive phase of the orchard including the establishment phase per year of lifetime (30 years, 256 trees/ha planted), the clearing of the orchard including waste treatment. The establishment phase of the orchard includes tree nursery, soil cultivation, planting trees, sowing grass, and irrigation. Fertiliser and pesticide use in a year of the establishment phase is assumed to be half of the amount of a year in the productive phase. The productive phase includes machine operations, corresponding infrastructure, fuel use, sheds, soil cultivation, fertiliser and pesticide application, harvesting and irrigation. Direct field emissions and land use change are included. The dataset doesn't include emissions from manure storage because these are within the system boundary of animal production.
General information.Tags: lemon, citrus production, agriculture, LCA, ecoinvent, Mexico, WFLDB

processDocumentation.LCI method: WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products.
processDocumentation.Process type: Ordinary transforming activity; Agricultural production, cradle-to-farm gate.
processDocumentation.Modeling constants: System model: Allocation, cut-off. Orchard lifetime: 30 years. Tree density: 256 trees/ha.
processDocumentation.Data source information: Data sources were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4). Yield: L1 (FAOSTAT); Fertilisers: L1; Pesticides: L0; Machinery: L0; Irrigation: L2. References include Ozkan B. (2004), EEA (2013), IPCC (2006), Freiermuth R. (2006), Prasuhn V. (2006), Nemecek T. et al. (2015).
processDocumentation.Data completeness: The dataset includes all activities within the defined system boundary, from nursery to waste treatment of the cleared orchard. Emissions from manure storage are excluded as they are part of the animal production system boundary.
processDocumentation.Data selection: Data selection aimed at representing lemons produced in Mexico for the export market.
processDocumentation.Data treatment: Data treatment included adapting statistical data (L1) to the specific crop and country (L2), using literature data approved by experts (L3), and using proxies or estimates (L0).
processDocumentation.Sampling procedure: WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products in the latest version, available at: (Report section: https://v30.ecoquery.ecoinvent.org/File/Reports). Data sources: Data were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) as follows: L0 = estimate, proxy; L1 = statistical data (e.g. FAOSTAT); L2 = L1 adapted to crop and country; L3 = literature data or L1 resp. L2 data approved by experts; medium detailing (i.e. kg of total N-fertiliser); L4 = L3 data of high detailing (i.e. portion N-fertiliser types).In this dataset data were obtained for yield: L1; Fertilisers: L1; Pesticides: L0; Machinery: L0; Irrigation: L2.
processDocumentation.Use advice: This dataset refers to an average situation; for specific situations exchanges might differ substantially due to site specific parameters.
processDocumentation.Completeness: PEF-Quality: data quality rating (DQR) = 3.2 (i.e. fair quality).
